data_used.cell_metadata: GSE96583_batch2.total.tsne.df.tsv.gz (per-cell: condition 'stim', donor 'ind', cell type 'cell', doublet status 'multiplets', cluster, tSNE coordinates)
data_used.gene_annotation: GSE96583_batch2.genes.tsv.gz (Ensembl gene id -> gene symbol, in matrix row order)
data_used.labels_used: condition (ctrl vs stim), donor (ind, 8 donors), cell type (cell, 8 labels), doublet status (multiplets: kept singlets only)
data_used.experiment: GSE96583 batch 2 (samples 2.1 control vs 2.2 IFN-beta stimulated); batch 1 (samples A/B/C) is a separate unstimulated multiplexing demo and was not used

model: Pseudobulk DESeq2 (PyDESeq2 0.5.4): raw counts summed per donor x condition (8 donors x 2 conditions = 16 samples), negative-binomial Wald test with design '~ donor + condition' (donor as fixed-effect covariate, parametric dispersion trend), contrast stimulated vs control; Cook's distance outlier filtering and independent filtering enabled, Benjamini-Hochlinger FDR on the unfiltered gene set. Analysis repeated for all cells and within each of the 8 provided cell-type labels.
software_used: Python 3.14.7; scanpy 1.12.1; anndata 0.12.16; pandas 2.3.3; numpy 2.4.3; scipy 1.14.1; matplotlib 3.10.3 (with a local monkeypatch for a Path.__deepcopy__ recursion bug on Python 3.14); PyDESeq2 0.5.4 (installed from a local uv cache wheel because PyPI was unreachable, with formulaic 1.2.2 and formulaic-contrasts 1.0.0 dependencies)
